hook: Mokila plot buyers *can't register* HMDA auction plots
hook_b: Mokila plot buyers *can't register* HMDA auction plots
tldr: Revenue authorities put parts of Survey No 96/P at Mokila on the prohibited list under Section 22A of the Registration Act. So buyers who won Phase 3 and 4 plots in HMDA's official auctions cannot complete registration. HMDA says a proposal to fix it is with the state government.

beats.what: Buyers of HMDA-auctioned plots in Mokila Phases 3 and 4 are unable to register their properties.
beats.why: Parts of Survey No 96/P were included in the prohibited properties list under Section 22A of the Registration Act; removal needs senior Revenue approvals and a District Collector NOC, still pending.
beats.care: Plot buyers along the Hyderabad-Shankarpally road who paid at auction are waiting on the state to clear the land.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat (Nov 19): HMDA Metropolitan Commissioner Sarfaraz Ahmad said a proposal to address the registration issue has been submitted to the state government.

cards.q: Who should move first to fix the Mokila registration block?

qs: How long have Phase 3-4 buyers been waiting since their auctions?
Are other HMDA layouts caught in the 22A prohibited list?

facts.t: The highest Mokila bid reached *₹1.09 lakh per square yard*.
HMDA developed over 1,290 plots across *165 acres* along the Hyderabad-Shankarpally road.

viz.verdict: Over half of HMDA's Mokila plots are sold; Phase 3-4 buyers cannot register yet

viz.l: What has to happen before buyers can register

steps.e: Parts of Survey No 96/P on 22A prohibited list
HMDA proposal with the state government

learn.t: Section 22A = the Registration Act rule that lets the state bar registration of listed (prohibited) properties.

watch: Whether the state clears the proposal and the Collector issues the NOC to delist the survey number.
